payload.description: fgos setup in a project other than the fgOS source repo runs fixes that only belong to the fgOS repo. Seen 2026-10-08 in ~/projects/mcp-skill-hub after fgctl init + fgos setup: it created docs/decisions/index.md, docs/doc-registry.json, docs/doc-registry.md, docs/enduser-docs-index.json, and set core.hooksPath to <project>/.githooks, a directory that does not exist there (silently disabling any .git/hooks the project had). The owner removed those by hand and unset core.hooksPath; the next fgos setup or doctor --fix will write them again. Expected: in a non-fgOS project, setup/doctor --fix apply only project-level fixes (activation shim, agent hooks, config); fgOS-repo fixes (doc registry, decision index, end-user docs index, main-checkout git hook) are skipped and their doctor checks report not-applicable. Verify with a fresh outside project: fgctl init, fgos setup, then git status shows only .fgos/ and agent hook files, and core.hooksPath stays unset.
payload.title: fgos setup in a project other than the fgOS source repo runs fixes that only belong to the fgOS repo
